data.script:
line(sma($price.close, options.fastLength), color=options.fastColor, lineStyle=0)
line(ema($price.close, options.fastLength), color=options.fastColor, lineStyle=2)
line(sma($price.close, options.mediumLength), color=options.mediumColor, lineStyle=0)
line(ema($price.close, options.mediumLength), color=options.mediumColor, lineStyle=2)
line(sma($price.close, options.slowLength), color=options.slowColor, lineStyle=0)
line(ema($price.close, options.slowLength), color=options.slowColor, lineStyle=2)
data.description: Three EMA and SMA pairs on the price chart, with matching periods. Solid SMA; dashed EMA.
data.author: InstinctforJohn
